question: My website displays correctly on PC and smartphone, but not on a tablet. The words on the page are off the screen.
candidate_answer:
To address the issue of words being off the screen on tablets, consider the following based on workflow context for page customization:

- Check the responsive design settings in your site editor, especially for the Events Details and Registration Form pages, as customizations (colors, fonts, hiding elements) affect all devices and events [S2].
- Verify if any fixed-width elements or large fonts are causing overflow on tablet screen sizes; adjust these settings to use relative sizing or flexible layouts.
- Use the Settings icon in the Editor to review page display toggles and ensure elements are not positioned outside the visible area on medium-sized screens like tablets [S1].
- Test and preview your site in tablet view within the editor to identify which elements cause the overflow and adjust accordingly.

If the problem persists, consider adding custom CSS or consulting device-specific layout options to improve tablet compatibility.

To resolve this issue:

question: I am trying to change the order of the items within a CMS collection on my Wix site, but the provided steps did not work for me.
candidate_answer:
To change the order of items within a CMS collection on your Wix site, please consider the following steps:

- **Sort the Collection via Dataset Settings:**  
  Go to the page with your dataset connected to the CMS collection. Click on the dataset, then open its settings. Under the "Sort" section, add sorting rules based on the fields you want (e.g., date, title, custom order number).

- **Use a Custom Field for Manual Ordering:**  
  If you want a specific custom order, add a number field (e.g., "Order") to your collection. Assign values to each item to represent their order, then sort the dataset by this field.

- **Refresh and Publish:**  
  After adjusting sorting, refresh your page preview and publish the site to see changes live.

- **Check for Caching or Dataset Filters:**  
  Ensure no filters or cached data are overriding your sorting settings.

If these steps did not work, please verify that you are editing the correct dataset connected to the page and that your dataset is set to "Read & Write" mode if you want to reorder items dynamically.

If issues persist, providing more details about your current setup or error messages will help diagnose the problem.
gt_answer:
To change the order of items within a CMS collection on your Wix site, you should follow these steps:

1. Go to the CMS in your site's dashboard or editor.
2. Click on the relevant collection.
3. If you have multiple collection views, select the view you want to sort items in.
4. Click 'Sort' at the top of your collection.
5. Click '+ Add a Sort'.
6. Choose the field you want to sort by from the 'Sort by' drop-down menu.
7. Select the sorting order (e.g., A-Z, Low-High, Oldest-Newest).
8. Click 'Add Sort'.
9. To apply this order to your live site, enable the 'Mirror on Site' toggle at the top of the collection.

If these steps did not work, ensure that the 'Mirror on Site' feature is enabled, as this is necessary for the order in your collection view to be reflected on your live site. Additionally, check if there are any sort conditions added to datasets, as these can override the order set in your mirrored collection view. For more detailed guidance, you can refer to the [Wix support article on mirroring item order](https://support.wix.com/en/article/cms-mirroring-the-order-of-items-in-your-collection-to-your-sites-connected-elements).

To customize your store layout and image display:
Click the Layout tab to select the best Product Page layout for your shop. Then, customize how images are displayed.
1. Click the Layout tab and select a layout for the Product Page.
2. Click the Stretch to full width toggle to enable it. 
3. Select how you want to display image thumbnails under Show thumbnails.
4. Click the Image ratio drop-down and select a ratio.
5. Select an option under How's image resized:
  - Crop: Crops all images to the same size.
  - Fit: Maintains the images' aspect ratios.
6. Click the Zoom on image toggle to enable it (available for some layouts). 
Note: To preview the zoom, go to your live site.

Tip: Click Reset to original layout to reset your Product Page to its original layout settings. 

Learn more about [displaying images in your store](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-setting-how-store-images-are-displayed).
